note: Jieli 0xAB protocol, from sadhana-rn/src/soulsync/ring (codec.ts, device.ts). Every command = 'frame' (CMD Key KeyFlag hex) + 'args'; the portal adds the AB header + CRC16 and writes to b002, replies arrive on b003. resp_offset counts from the first payload byte after CMD/Key/KeyFlag. Confirmed on hardware 2026-11-16: vibration {2,11,0} and info {2,99,16} are ACKed. Do NOT point anything at service FF00 - that is the ring's OTA channel. OLED: no remote command found that lights the screen (tested 2026-11-16 on SR16-1: LED {2,102,0}, call alert {6,4,16}, message push {4,1,0}, photo mode {6,1,0} - all ACKed, screen stayed dark; 0xDC/0xDB are drink-reminder {2,33,x}). Buzz is vibration only.

battery.note: {2,3,16} battery (RWfit x5/b.java G, msg id 0xF3): payload[0] = percent, payload[1..2] = voltage

vibration.note: {2,11,0} [level 1-3, pulse count] (device.ts setVibration). Ring buzzes 'count' pulses; Buzz repeats it every buzz_repeat_s until Stop.

hr.note: Live HR (confirmed on worn ring 2026-11-16): arm {6,9,0}[03 05 01], ring pushes {2,36,0} every 1-3 s, payload [ts32 BE, bpm, 0]; disarmed when the stage ends. The ring switches live HR off by itself after ~30 s (sends {6,9,0}[03 05 00]); the portal re-arms it.

spo2.note: SpO2: newest of the ring's own stored readings (taken ~every 10 min while worn). Pull {5,9,16} + ACK {5,9,48}; records [ts32 BE secs since 2000 local, value, pad]. Reading DELETES the stored pages from the ring.

hrv.note: HRV: newest of the ring's own stored readings (taken ~every 10 min while worn). Pull {5,10,16} + ACK {5,10,48}; records [ts32 BE secs since 2000 local, value, pad]. Reading DELETES the stored pages from the ring.

count.note: Japa bead count: the ring pushes {2,0x53,0} on every bead tap, records [ts32 BE, count32 BE]; value = the ring's own running total in the last record (sadhana-rn japaCounter.ts). Tap the ring 2+ times during the stage.

steps.note: Today's step total: pull {5,26,16} and {5,2,16} (+ACK); 16-byte records [ts32 BE, pad, steps24 BE, cal, dist]. Hour-aligned records are hourly buckets and are skipped; the record stamped 'now' is the running daily total (sadhana-rn sync.ts decodeSteps). Shake/walk with the ring during the stage. Reading DELETES stored step pages.

time.note: SR16 has no clock getter ({2,1,16} replies empty). Apply = set {2,1,0}[yy mm dd hh mi ss] (UTC + tz + shift), then 'wake' = {6,9,0}[03 05 01] + [03 05 00] (HR on/off - a stop frame alone does not light the screen) so the ring shows its date/time page. Read = no ring commands; shows the clock as kept since the portal set it.

mode.note: SR16 has no display-mode switch. Each portal mode runs the SR16 command for that function and is OK only if the ring answers every frame. Frames are CMD Key KeyFlag + payload hex. steps/sleep: no SR16 command (N/A). The factory self-test ({2,103,0}[1], read {2,112,16} -> [Gsensor, Heart, Wear], {2,103,0}[0]) answers on hardware (SR16-1: 1,1,254) but exiting it reboots the ring, so it is not used as a mode. HR/SpO2 modes leave the live measurement running so the ring stays on that page (the ring itself ends it after ~30-60 s); every other mode stops HR and SpO2 first. Time mode: set clock, then HR on/off 0.3 s apart so the screen wakes on the date/time page. Counter mode: no screen wake (it would land on date/time); waits up to tap_wait_s for the ring's bead-count push {2,0x53,0} (no command opens the counter page - open it on the ring and tap); OK shows the ring's count. tap_wait_s is 0 (off): on 2026-11-16 no ring sent a count - the counter page could not be opened on the ring and the chanting switch {2,120,16} already reads 1. Set tap_wait_s to e.g. 60 once the ring's counter gesture is known. Steps mode: no command shows the steps page; it stops HR/SpO2 (ring must answer) then pulls the stored step records and shows the newest total in the portal (pull deletes the ring's step pages).

power.note: SR16 has no power-off command. Off/On = health-monitor master {2,14,0} [0]=low power (sensors off) / [1]=sensors on (sadhana-rn setHealthMonitorMaster).
